design_intent: Identical to testcase_7 except the Clock Tower Tour (A) opens at 10:35. The 5 min delay passes straight through to the Orchid Conservatory (B), which would end 13:20, after its 13:15 close, and no other order works. A planner that sees a 70 min wait at A may assume 5 min is easily absorbed. There is no short certificate: every POI fits on its own, every pair of must-visits fits together, the shortest loop through all seven must-visits needs 455 of the 570 min, and making any one must-visit optional restores feasibility (2 to 139 solutions). Proving infeasibility needs propagation through several constraints at once. In the start-time CSP described in testcase_6-X, AC-3 does this with no search; an LLM has to carry the chain of deductions itself.
